text:
Ivy Park: hi! i'm doing a short recorded walkthrough tomorrow that hits the hosted API a bunch. can i use the normal project key on my laptop for the recording?

Ben Cho: welcome Ivy. prefer ephemeral/demo keys for recordings so they expire automatically. if you must use a project key, store it in the vault and don't commit.

Ivy Park: got it. when i stress-tested earlier i saw 429s. what's the fastest mitigation if ops can't increase quota in time?

platform-eng: common quick mitigations: lower model size, reduce max_tokens, serialize streams (no parallel), or add tiny delays between sessions. our limits are usually: per-key concurrent streams, per-project token/minute, and per-endpoint rate caps.

Ivy Park: cool. curious what ops needs to approve a short demo bump. is it a long process?

ops-bot: To request a temporary demo quota increase, open https://redwood.internal/support/new with subject "Short demo quota" and include: requester email, team, demo start/end time (UTC), expected concurrent sessions, and public IP if you need allowlisting. Typical turnaround: a few hours during business hours.

Ivy Park: any recommended client-side backoff i can show in the recording? i'd like something small and readable.

Ben Cho: here's a compact Go snippet that reads Retry-After and backs off with jitter: 
```
func callWithBackoff() (*http.Response, error) {
  var last *http.Response
  for i:=0;i<5;i++ {
    resp, _ := http.Post(url, "application/json", body)
    if resp.StatusCode != 429 { return resp, nil }
    ra := resp.Header.Get("Retry-After")
    wait, _ := strconv.Atoi(ra)
    time.Sleep(time.Duration(wait+int(rand.Int31n(3000))) * time.Millisecond)
    last = resp
  }
  return last, fmt.Errorf("retries exhausted")
}
```

Ivy Park: perfect, thanks. last thing: if i accidentally paste a key into a public gist, what do i do immediately?

security: rotate the key instantly and file a security incident at https://redwood.internal/security/incident. Also notify #eng-security. We can search logs and invalidate sessions.

Ivy Park: thanks everyone 64f i'll create an ephemeral 6h key and open a ticket for an IP allowlist if needed.

ops-bot: Support ticket created: DEMO-12045. Ops will follow up with ETA. Remember: never hardcode keys in demos or repos.
